summary: First Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.24 per share declared by its board, payable July 24, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. The press release highlights strong Q1 2026 results and a commitment to disciplined capital management. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activism, restructuring, or tender offer. This filing is a routine dividend announcement by the issuer with no structural premium, deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle.
